title: Porting, Configuration and Migrations
description: Porting the Java Foundations Javalin route, service and repository to Spring Boot with constructor injection across layers, a REST design recap, configuration files and profiles, secrets read from the environment, and versioned schema migrations with Flyway.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Standard S1-S13 and Fast FT1-FT8. This module covers Standard S3-S4.
Fast mapping: FT2 rows 0 and 4-6 and FT4 row 3 (Flyway) map here. constructor-injection-across-layers has no Fast row (Standard-only).
Module coding lab authored at coding-lab/ (Standard lab overlay): mvn -q -o test, offline after one setup, no container engine; Fast skips coding labs.

Practice mastery check authored at assessments/porting-and-configuration-mastery-check/ (blueprint plus learner-visible practice.gift, ungraded, 15 minutes at most); the graded course final is the separate course-level blueprint spring-boot/assessments/spring-boot-final-assessment.
